advancements.story.cutting_edge.title: Embracing the Cutting Edge
advancements.story.cutting_edge.descript: Harvest Flint from Gravel and Sticks from Leaves and make your first tool with an Axe Head
advancements.story.copper_ingot.title: Acquire Software
tutorial.affogatocore.get_sticks.title: Get some sticks
tutorial.affogatocore.get_sticks.descrip: Punch tree leaves to collect sticks
tutorial.affogatocore.get_flint.title: Get some flint
message.affogatocore.penchant_level_up_r: %s is ready at an enchanting table
advancements.affogatocore.obtain_armor.d: Protect yourself with a piece of Copper Armor. Get a full set and a Shield before venturing into caves
advancements.affogatocore.smelt_iron.des: Smelt an Iron Ingot. Mining and smelting ore are some of the best ways to gain experience
advancements.affogatocore.enchant_item.d: Enchant an item at an Enchanting Table. Enchantments level up as you use your gear, and applying a level-up costs experience at the table
advancements.affogatocore.obtain_ancient: Obtain Ancient Debris. It generates in larger veins at any height and can be exposed to air
advancements.affogatocore.elytra.descrip: Find Elytra. Fireworks no longer boost your flight, so launch from Campfire updrafts instead.
advancements.affogatocore.totem_of_undyi: Use a Totem of Undying to cheat death. Totems can be found in the chests of some structures
advancements.affogatocore.voluntary_exil: Kill a raid captain. Killing enough Pillagers at an outpost stops them from spawning there
advancements.affogatocore.brew_potion.ca: Brew a potion. Cauldrons can brew potions too
advancements.affogatocore.brew_potion.go: Brew a potion. Golden food can be brewed into potions
advancements.affogatocore.brew_potion.bo: Brew a potion. Cauldrons can brew potions too, and Golden food can be brewed into potions
advancements.affogatocore.fishy_business: Catch a fish. You hook the actual fish swimming in the water, so cast near them
advancements.affogatocore.revaulting.des: Use an Ominous Trial Key on an Ominous Vault. Ominous Vaults are the only source of mace enchantments
advancements.affogatocore.liquid_knowled: Obtain a %s. Mobs, fishing and trading give no experience, but these can be found in chests all over the world
advancements.affogatocore.hearty_meal.de: Eat something. Eating takes longer and stops when you take damage, and health regenerates slowly, so eat away from danger
advancements.affogatocore.low_profile.de: Sneak while a monster is in sight. Sneaking makes it much harder for monsters to notice you
Obtain a Shield. Raise it just before a projectile hits to parry it, strike with a sword after blocking for a Critical Counter, and bash enemies away with %s if it has Bash
advancements.affogatocore.pack_mule.desc: Obtain a Backpack. Equip it as an accessory or attach it to a chestplate, then press %s to open it
advancements.affogatocore.tool_belt.desc: Obtain a Tool Pouch. Tools and gadgets stored inside keep working from the pouch, and %s opens it
advancements.affogatocore.off_the_grid.d: Obtain a filled Map. Coordinates are disabled, so combine a map with a Book to make an Atlas, which powers your world map (%s) and minimap
advancements.affogatocore.plant_your_fla: Place a Banner. Turn it into a waypoint on the locator bar by naming it with a name tag before placing it, or binding it to an atlas or map
advancements.affogatocore.ancient_wisdom: Defeat an Elder Guardian. They are the only source of trident enchantments
advancements.affogatocore.second_helping: Reset a Vault you have already looted by using a Block of Emerald on it
advancements.affogatocore.cold_storage.d: Loot an igloo basement chest. Frost Walker books are only found in igloos and Ancient City ice boxes
Loot a Desert Pyramid chest. Curse books are only found in Desert Pyramids
advancements.affogatocore.seasonal_worke: Obtain a Calendar. Out of season crops grow slower, so use it to keep track of the current season
